name: rsk_getRawBlockHeaderByNumber
summary: Returns the RLP-encoded header of the block at the given number or tag.
description: Returns the block header exactly as it is encoded for consensus, so it can be hashed or verified independently. Returns `null` when no block matches the given number or tag.

result.name: rawBlockHeader
result.description: The RLP-encoded block header, or `null` if no block matches

examples.name: getRawBlockHeaderByNumberExample
examples.description: The result is abridged; a real encoded header is several hundred bytes long
